mapper.insert: INSERT INTO train_runner_command (command_uuid, runner_id, command_type, payload, idempotency_key, status, lease_until, attempt_count, result, error_code, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{commandUuid}, #{runnerId}, #{commandType}, #{payload}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{status}, #{leaseUntil}, #{attemptCount}, #{result}, #{errorCode}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM train_runner_command WHERE command_uuid = #{commandUuid} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM train_runner_command WHERE runner_id = #{runnerId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT command_id FROM train_runner_command WHERE runner_id = #{runnerId} AND (status = 'QUEUED' OR (status = 'LEASED' AND lease_until < #{now})) ORDER BY created_at, command_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
